Ben Shelton: Ben Shelton brings solid form into the semi-finals at the ATP Finals in Turin, having advanced to the knockout rounds following a win over Rafael Jodar. His recent results in the group stage include a victory against Arthur Fils and a defeat to Alexander Zverev, setting up an upcoming semi-final clash against Carlos Alcaraz.
Carlos Alcaraz: Carlos Alcaraz enters the match carrying some physical problems and injury concerns, though he has managed them while taking care of the issue. Despite these fitness worries, he is in excellent form with a flawless, unbeaten run at the ATP Finals, highlighted by recent victories over Daniil Medvedev and Flavio Cobolli to secure his place in the semi-finals.
Alexander Zverev: World No. 1 Alexander Zverev enters this match in strong tournament form after defeating Ben Shelton to secure his place in the ATP Finals semi-finals, having also received his year-end No. 1 trophy in Turin. However, his rise to the top ranking has been accompanied by a troubled start and a wretched top-10 record. Additionally, Zverev is dealing with off-court distractions after being notified of a fresh lawsuit from a former partner during the event.
Daniil Medvedev: Daniil Medvedev recently suffered a straight-sets defeat to Carlos Alcaraz at the ATP Finals following an earlier win-or-go-home clash. He bounced back to defeat Frances Tiafoe, successfully booking a spot in the semi-finals of the tournament.
